text: Mia Bonta, running for the California State Assembly's AD-18 district, has not called the war in Gaza a genocide, has not backed blocking weapons transfers to Israel, and has not taken divestment action. What she has done is push back on AB 715, the antisemitism-coordinator bill whose provisions touch speech about Palestine: she was identified as a skeptic of the measure, pressured its co-authors to clean it up after a late-night passage, and ultimately voted for it in September 2025. On the broader Palestine question, CAIR Action lists her as preferred, Vote for Peace rates her an Ally, and AROC Action endorsed her, while the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club also carried her name as an endorsed candidate. Her legislative platform spans defending Medi-Cal from federal cuts, expanding universal preschool, creating affordable housing across income levels, protecting sanctuary policies for immigrants, and holding corporations accountable for redlining and consolidation in the East Bay.
